Meetings and Public Question Time

Meetings

Council Meetings commence at 1:00pm and will be advertised in accordance with the provisions of the Local Government Act 1995. Meetings are open to the public unless items of a confidential nature are being discussed. In these circumstances, a resolution will be passed by the Council, and members of the public, members of the press and non-essential staff will be asked to leave the meeting. The agenda for each meeting sets out the items of business to be considered and the order in which they will be dealt with.

The Agenda for the current Council Meeting is made available 5 days prior to the meeting. Minutes of the Meeting will be available within 10 working days of the meeting. Please see 'Agendas and Minutes' to access agendas and minutes.

Public Question Time

In accordance with the Local Government Act (Administration) Regulations, members of the public are given an opportunity to ask a question of Council.

All questions asked must relate to Local Government or a topic covered in the Agenda of a particular meeting.
